description: BIOS, firmware and driver updates with the vendor tools: Dell Command Update, Lenovo System Update and HP Image Assistant, which install-tool installs with winget. Other vendors are reported as not supported.

scan.description: Applicable BIOS, firmware and driver updates

install-tool.description: Install the vendor tool with winget when missing (workstations only); scan never installs

install.description: Install updates by type; BIOS only when include_bios is set; never reboots
